classes.name: TCollection_AsciiString
classes.summary:
Class defines a variable-length sequence of 8-bit characters. Despite class name (kept for historical reasons), it is intended to store UTF-8 string, not just ASCII characters. However, multi-byte nature of UTF-8 is not considered by the following methods:
- Method ::Length() return the number of bytes, not the number of Unicode symbols.
- Methods taking/returning symbol index work with 8-bit code units, not true Unicode symbols, including ::Remove(), ::SetValue(), ::Value(), ::Search(), ::Trunc() and others. If application needs to process multi-byte Unicode symbols explicitly, `NCollection_UtfIterator<char>` class can be used for iterating through Unicode string (UTF-32 code unit will be returned for each position).
Class provides editing operations with built-in memory management to make AsciiString objects easier to use than ordinary character arrays. AsciiString objects follow value semantics; in other words, they are the actual strings, not handles to strings, and are copied through assignment. You may use HAsciiString objects to get handles to strings.

instanceMethods.name: Token
instanceMethods.comment:
Extracts whichone token from this string. By default, the separators is set to space and tabulation. By default, the token extracted is the first one (whichone = 1). separators contains all separators you need. If no token indexed by whichone is found, it returns empty AsciiString.

@param theSeparators the separator characters
@param theWhichOne the token number to extract

classes.name: TCollection_ExtendedString
classes.summary:
A variable-length sequence of "extended" (UNICODE) characters (16-bit character type). It provides editing operations with built-in memory management to make ExtendedString objects easier to use than ordinary extended character arrays. ExtendedString objects follow "value semantics", that is, they are the actual strings, not handles to strings, and are copied through assignment. You may use HExtendedString objects to get handles to strings.
Beware that class can transparently store UTF-16 string with surrogate pairs (Unicode symbol represented by two 16-bit code units). However, surrogate pairs are not considered by the following methods:
- Method ::Length() return the number of 16-bit code units, not the number of Unicode symbols.
- Methods taking/returning symbol index work with 16-bit code units, not true Unicode symbols, including ::Remove(), ::SetValue(), ::Value(), ::Search(), ::Trunc() and others. If application needs to process surrogate pairs, `NCollection_UtfIterator<char16_t>` class can be used for iterating through Unicode string (UTF-32 code unit will be returned for each position).

classes.name: TCollection_HAsciiString
classes.summary:
A variable-length sequence of ASCII characters (normal 8-bit character type). It provides editing operations with built-in memory management to make HAsciiString objects easier to use than ordinary character arrays. HAsciiString objects are handles to strings.
- HAsciiString strings may be shared by several objects.
- You may use an AsciiString object to get the actual string. Note: HAsciiString objects use an AsciiString string as a field.

instanceMethods.name: AssignCat
instanceMethods.comment: Appends <other> to me. Example: aString = aString + anotherString.

instanceMethods.name: Capitalize
instanceMethods.comment: Converts the first character into its corresponding upper-case character and the other characters into lowercase. Example: before me = "hellO " after me = "Hello ".

instanceMethods.name: Cat
instanceMethods.comment: Creates a new string by concatenation of this ASCII string and the other ASCII string. Example: aString = aString + anotherString aString = aString + "Dummy" aString contains "I say " aString = aString + "Hello " + "Dolly" gives "I say Hello Dolly" Warning: To catenate more than one CString, you must put a String before. So the following example is WRONG ! aString = "Hello " + "Dolly" THIS IS NOT ALLOWED This rule is applicable to AssignCat (operator +=) too.

instanceMethods.name: Cat
instanceMethods.comment: Creates a new string by concatenation of this ASCII string and the other ASCII string. Example: aString = aString + anotherString.

instanceMethods.name: Center
instanceMethods.comment: Modifies this ASCII string so that its length becomes equal to Width and the new characters are equal to Filler. New characters are added both at the beginning and at the end of this string. If Width is less than the length of this ASCII string, nothing happens. Example `occ::handle<TCollection_HAsciiString>` myAlphabet = new {@link TCollection_HAsciiString | `TCollection_HAsciiString`} ("abcdef"); myAlphabet->Center(9,' '); assert ( !strcmp( myAlphabet->`ToCString()`, " abcdef ") );.

instanceMethods.name: ChangeAll
instanceMethods.signature: (aChar: string, NewChar: string, CaseSensitive?: boolean): void
instanceMethods.comment: Replaces all characters equal to aChar by NewChar in this ASCII string. The substitution is case sensitive if CaseSensitive is true (default value). If you do not use the default case sensitive option, it does not matter whether aChar is upper-case or not. Example `occ::handle<TCollection_HAsciiString>` myMistake = new {@link TCollection_HAsciiString | `TCollection_HAsciiString`} ("Hather"); myMistake->ChangeAll('H','F'); assert ( !strcmp( myMistake->`ToCString()`, "Father") );.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Removes all characters contained in <me>. This produces an empty HAsciiString.

instanceMethods.name: FirstLocationInSet
instanceMethods.signature: (Set: TCollection_HAsciiString, FromIndex: number, ToIndex: number): number
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the index of the first character of <me> that is present in <Set>. The search begins to the index FromIndex and ends to the the index ToIndex. Returns zero if failure. Raises an exception if FromIndex or ToIndex is out of range Example: before me = "aabAcAa", S = "Aa", FromIndex = 1, Toindex = 7 after me = "aabAcAa" returns 1.

instanceMethods.name: FirstLocationNotInSet
instanceMethods.signature: (Set: TCollection_HAsciiString, FromIndex: number, ToIndex: number): number
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the index of the first character of <me> that is not present in the set <Set>. The search begins to the index FromIndex and ends to the the index ToIndex in <me>. Returns zero if failure. Raises an exception if FromIndex or ToIndex is out of range. Example: before me = "aabAcAa", S = "Aa", FromIndex = 1, Toindex = 7 after me = "aabAcAa" returns 3.

instanceMethods.name: Insert
instanceMethods.comment: Insert a Character at position <where>. Example: aString contains "hy not ?" aString.Insert(1,'W'); gives "Why not ?" aString contains "Wh" aString.Insert(3,'y'); gives "Why" aString contains "Way" aString.Insert(2,'h'); gives "Why".

instanceMethods.name: Insert
instanceMethods.comment: Insert a HAsciiString at position <where>.

instanceMethods.name: InsertAfter
instanceMethods.comment: Inserts the other ASCII string a after a specific index in the string <me> Example: before me = "cde" , Index = 0 , other = "ab" after me = "abcde" , other = "ab".

instanceMethods.name: InsertBefore
instanceMethods.comment: Inserts the other ASCII string a before a specific index in the string <me> Raises an exception if Index is out of bounds Example: before me = "cde" , Index = 1 , other = "ab" after me = "abcde" , other = "ab".

instanceMethods.name: IsEmpty
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the string <me> contains zero character.

instanceMethods.comment: Converts a HAsciiString containing a numeric expression to an Integer. Example: "215" returns 215.

instanceMethods.name: IsIntegerValue
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the string contains an integer value.

instanceMethods.name: IsRealValue
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the string contains a real value.

instanceMethods.name: IsAscii
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the string contains only ASCII characters between ' ' and '~'. This means no control character and no extended ASCII code.

instanceMethods.name: IsDifferent
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the string S not contains same characters than the string <me>.

instanceMethods.name: IsSameString
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the string S contains same characters than the string <me>.

instanceMethods.name: IsSameString
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the string S contains same characters than the string <me>.

instanceMethods.name: LeftAdjust
instanceMethods.comment: Removes all space characters in the beginning of the string.

instanceMethods.name: LeftJustify
instanceMethods.comment: Left justify. Length becomes equal to Width and the new characters are equal to Filler if Width < Length nothing happens Raises an exception if Width is less than zero Example: before me = "abcdef" , Width = 9 , Filler = ' ' after me = "abcdef ".

instanceMethods.name: Length
instanceMethods.comment: Returns number of characters in <me>. This is the same functionality as 'strlen' in C.

instanceMethods.name: Location
instanceMethods.signature: (other: TCollection_HAsciiString, FromIndex: number, ToIndex: number): number
instanceMethods.comment: returns an index in the string <me> of the first occurrence of the string S in the string <me> from the starting index FromIndex to the ending index ToIndex returns zero if failure Raises an exception if FromIndex or ToIndex is out of range. Example: before me = "aabAaAa", S = "Aa", FromIndex = 1, ToIndex = 7 after me = "aabAaAa" returns 4

instanceMethods.name: Location
instanceMethods.signature: (N: number, C: string, FromIndex: number, ToIndex: number): number
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the index of the nth occurrence of the character C in the string <me> from the starting index FromIndex to the ending index ToIndex. Returns zero if failure. Raises an exception if FromIndex or ToIndex is out of range Example: before me = "aabAa", N = 3, C = 'a', FromIndex = 1, ToIndex = 5 after me = "aabAa" returns 5.

instanceMethods.name: LowerCase
instanceMethods.comment: Converts <me> to its lower-case equivalent.

instanceMethods.name: Prepend
instanceMethods.comment: Inserts the other string at the beginning of the string <me> Example: before me = "cde" , S = "ab" after me = "abcde" , S = "ab".

instanceMethods.name: RealValue
instanceMethods.comment: Converts a string containing a numeric expression to a Real. Example: "215" returns 215.0. "3.14159267" returns 3.14159267.

instanceMethods.name: RemoveAll
instanceMethods.comment: Remove all the occurrences of the character C in the string Example: before me = "HellLLo", C = 'L' , CaseSensitive = True after me = "Hello".

instanceMethods.name: RemoveAll
instanceMethods.comment: Removes every <what> characters from <me>.

instanceMethods.name: Remove
instanceMethods.comment: Erases <ahowmany> characters from position <where>, <where> included. Example: aString contains "Hello" aString.Erase(2,2) erases 2 characters from position 1 This gives "Hlo".

instanceMethods.name: RightAdjust
instanceMethods.comment: Removes all space characters at the end of the string.

instanceMethods.name: RightJustify
instanceMethods.comment: Right justify. Length becomes equal to Width and the new characters are equal to Filler if Width < Length nothing happens Raises an exception if Width is less than zero Example: before me = "abcdef" , Width = 9 , Filler = ' ' after me = " abcdef".

instanceMethods.name: Search
instanceMethods.comment: Searches a CString in <me> from the beginning and returns position of first item <what> matching. It returns -1 if not found. Example: aString contains "Sample single test" aString.Search("le") returns 5.

instanceMethods.name: Search
instanceMethods.comment: Searches a String in <me> from the beginning and returns position of first item <what> matching. it returns -1 if not found.

instanceMethods.name: SearchFromEnd
instanceMethods.comment: Searches a CString in a String from the end and returns position of first item <what> matching. It returns -1 if not found. Example: aString contains "Sample single test" aString.SearchFromEnd("le") returns 12.

instanceMethods.name: SearchFromEnd
instanceMethods.comment: Searches a HAsciiString in another HAsciiString from the end and returns position of first item <what> matching. It returns -1 if not found.

instanceMethods.name: SetValue
instanceMethods.comment: Replaces one character in the string at position <where>. If <where> is less than zero or greater than the length of <me> an exception is raised. Example: aString contains "Garbake" astring.Replace(6,'g') gives <me> = "Garbage".

instanceMethods.name: SetValue
instanceMethods.comment: Replaces a part of <me> in the string at position <where>. If <where> is less than zero or greater than the length of <me> an exception is raised. Example: aString contains "Garbake" astring.Replace(6,'g') gives <me> = "Garbage".

instanceMethods.name: SetValue
instanceMethods.comment: Replaces a part of <me> by another string.

instanceMethods.name: Split
instanceMethods.comment: Splits a HAsciiString into two sub-strings. Example: aString contains "abcdefg" aString.Split(3) gives <me> = "abc" and returns "defg".

instanceMethods.name: SubString
instanceMethods.comment: Creation of a sub-string of the string <me>. The sub-string starts to the index Fromindex and ends to the index ToIndex. Raises an exception if ToIndex or FromIndex is out of bounds Example: before me = "abcdefg", ToIndex=3, FromIndex=6 after me = "abcdefg" returns "cdef".

instanceMethods.name: ToCString
instanceMethods.comment: Returns pointer to string (char *) This is useful for some casual manipulations Because this "char *" is 'const', you can't modify its contents.

instanceMethods.name: Token
instanceMethods.comment:
Extracts <whichone> token from <me>. By default, the <separators> is set to space and tabulation. By default, the token extracted is the first one (whichone = 1). <separators> contains all separators you need. If no token indexed by <whichone> is found, it returns an empty String.
Example: aString contains "This is a message" aString.Token() returns "This" aString.Token(" ",4) returns "message" aString.Token(" ",2) returns "is" aString.Token(" ",9) returns "" Other separators than space character and tabulation are allowed aString contains "1234; test:message , value" aString.Token("; :,",4) returns "value" aString.Token("; :,",2) returns "test".

instanceMethods.name: Trunc
instanceMethods.comment: Truncates <me> to <ahowmany> characters. Example: me = "Hello Dolly" -> Trunc(3) -> me = "Hel".

instanceMethods.name: UpperCase
instanceMethods.comment: Converts <me> to its upper-case equivalent.

instanceMethods.name: UsefullLength
instanceMethods.comment: Length of the string ignoring all spaces (' ') and the control character at the end.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: Returns character at position <where> in <me>. If <where> is less than zero or greater than the length of <me>, an exception is raised. Example: aString contains "Hello" aString.Value(2) returns 'e'.

instanceMethods.name: String
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the field myString.
